observation_summary: An UnsupportedOperationException is thrown during argument verification or stubbing, particularly when dealing with varargs.
reasoning_summary: The stack traces consistently point to an UnsupportedOperationException occurring in InvocationMatcher.captureArgumentsFrom. This exception is typically thrown when attempting to modify an immutable or fixed-size collection (such as one returned by Arrays.asList or similar wrappers). Given that this method is responsible for capturing arguments—often involving varargs which are represented as arrays—the code is likely attempting to perform a mutation operation (like add or remove) on a collection that does not support it, leading to the failure during argument processing.
